mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Over near Fireman's Park, it is currently 50 degrees with overcast skies, feeling like 43 degrees. Tonight features a full moon, and although the International Space Station passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, the Plan Commission is set to review multiple development projects on Wednesday, November 4th, including the Ardent Glen addition and pending plans for Sub-Zero. Also, property tax bills will be mailed out by December 15th, with payment options available online, by mail, or via drop boxes.

Looking at local events, you can attend drop-in Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow brings Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and mark your calendars for the Main Street Trick or Treat on Thursday, October 29th.

In the weekly police recap, Verona Police arrested a school bus driver on Thursday afternoon for an O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. No students or bystanders were injured, and police are continuing to investigate the situation.
To wrap things up with a treat, Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, featuring Pumpkin Pecan as today's flavor of the day.
